answer.explanation: The live configuration of the CRUD API function drifts from the committed SAM template: MemorySize is 128 MB (template: 256) and Timeout is 3 s (template: 10). The config was last modified at 01:14:47Z, two seconds before the window opens, and the template and recent commits contain no matching change, so the change was made outside IaC. The logs in the window confirm the reduced memory is in effect (Memory Size: 128 MB, Max Memory Used about 90 MB). Durations were 65–400 ms, so the 3 s timeout did not fire, and a search for timeouts, errors, exceptions and AccessDenied returned no matches. The anomaly is therefore a latent configuration drift with no observed failures in this window. The other three functions match the template. The IAM roles and the function code show no anomaly.
